501: func (m *MatchRemoteIP) resolveTrustedProxy(r *http.Request, s *Server) (bool, string) {
502: 	if s == nil {
503: 		m.proxyTrusted = false
504: 		m.resolvedClientIP = ""
505: 		return false, ""
506: 	}
507: 	clientIP, err := m.splitRemoteAddr(r.RemoteAddr)
508: 	if err != nil {
509: 		return false, ""
510: 	}
511: 	clientIP = m.stripIPZone(clientIP)
512: 	ipAddr, err := m.parseRemoteIPAddr(clientIP)
513: 	if err != nil {
514: 		return false, ""
515: 	}
516: 	if s.trustedProxies == nil {
517: 		return m.setProxyResult(false, ipAddr.String())
518: 	}
519: 	m.loadTrustedNets(s.trustedProxies.GetIPRanges(r))
520: 	m.proxyHeaders = append(m.proxyHeaders[:0], s.ClientIPHeaders...)
521: 	if m.netsContain(ipAddr, m.trustedNets) {
522: 		if s.TrustedProxiesStrict > 0 {
523: 			return m.setProxyResult(true, m.lastUntrustedForwardedIP(r, m.proxyHeaders, m.trustedNets, ipAddr.String()))
524: 		}
525: 		return m.setProxyResult(true, m.firstValidForwardedIP(r, m.proxyHeaders, ipAddr.String()))
526: 	}
527: 	return m.setProxyResult(false, ipAddr.String())
528: }

756: func (m *MatchRemoteIP) headerValueMatches(actualFieldVal, allowedFieldVal string) bool {
757: 	m.workTokens = append(m.workTokens[:0], actualFieldVal, allowedFieldVal)
758: 	switch {
759: 	case allowedFieldVal == "*":
760: 		return true
761: 	case strings.HasPrefix(allowedFieldVal, "*") && strings.HasSuffix(allowedFieldVal, "*"):
762: 		return strings.Contains(actualFieldVal, allowedFieldVal[1:len(allowedFieldVal)-1])
763: 	case strings.HasPrefix(allowedFieldVal, "*"):
764: 		return strings.HasSuffix(actualFieldVal, allowedFieldVal[1:])
765: 	case strings.HasSuffix(allowedFieldVal, "*"):
766: 		return strings.HasPrefix(actualFieldVal, allowedFieldVal[:len(allowedFieldVal)-1])
767: 	default:
768: 		return actualFieldVal == allowedFieldVal
769: 	}

954: func (m *MatchRemoteIP) matchPatternWithEscapeSequence(escapedPath, matchPath string) bool {
955: 	m.workTokens = append(m.workTokens[:0], escapedPath, matchPath)

966: 			var err error
967: 			pathCh, err = url.PathUnescape(escapedPathCh)
968: 			if err != nil {
